name: On-Demand AI Assistant (Telegram → Claude API)
description: Listens for Telegram messages. Sends user input to Claude API with relevant context. Returns natural language answers instantly. Handles queries like 'What's my schedule today?', 'What's the gold price?', 'Summarize my emails'.

nodes.name: Telegram Bot Trigger
nodes.description: Listens for incoming messages to the bot

nodes.name: Route by Intent
nodes.description: Routes to correct data source based on message content (finance / calendar / weather / general)

nodes.name: Fetch Relevant Data
nodes.description: Fetches live data from appropriate API based on intent

nodes.name: Claude API — Generate Response
nodes.description: Sends user message + live data context to Claude API. Returns natural language answer.

parameters.note: Replace YOUR_CLAUDE_API_KEY with your Anthropic API key

nodes.name: Send Reply
nodes.description: Sends Claude's response back to the user in Telegram

example_queries: What's the gold price right now?
What do I have on my calendar today?
note: This is a documented workflow structure. API keys and credentials are not included.
